name: DAME_ASC
description: Device-Aware Multi-Expert Acoustic Scene Classification (ASC) system for cross-device robustness

commands.train_stage2: python src/train/train_stage2.py --config config.json --train_manifest data/manifests/train.json --init_ckpt runs/stage1_general/best.ckpt --all_devices --workdir runs/stage2_all
commands.infer: python src/infer/infer.py --config config.json --test_manifest data/manifests/test.json --general_ckpt runs/stage1_general/best.ckpt --device_ckpt_dir runs/stage2_all --out_csv runs/preds.csv

context.architecture: Multi-expert fusion with device-conditioned gating (DCF) and device-conditioned DIR bank (DCDIR)

modules.dame_asc/models/experts: Expert neural network implementations (PaSST, CNN, BEATs)
modules.src/train: Training scripts for Stage-1 and Stage-2
